About the Practice

Montefiore Einstein is a premier academic health system in New York, renowned for pushing boundaries in research, discoveries of life-saving cures, innovations in patient care, advancements in public health, and world-class medical education. [6, 9] It is comprised of 10 hospitals and more than 200 outpatient ambulatory care sites, offering highly specialized, coordinated care for diverse populations. [9, 11] Nationally recognized for its clinical excellence, Montefiore Einstein and its Albert Einstein College of Medicine represent the future of patient care, science and education, with a commitment to doing more for every patient in every community they serve. [9] The system includes numerous specialties such as cancer, heart & vascular care, neurology, and more. [6, 8]
